note:
Sources: City of Minneapolis building permit register (CCS_Permits), pulled 2026-10-17: building, remodel, roofing and wrecking permits still open and issued since Oct 17, 2025, one row per job address. Phone and email come from the Minnesota Department of Labor and Industry licence and registration lists, matched on company name (470 of 524 matched); otherwise the office is the address on the permit.

Homeowner-pulled permits and solar and drain-tile jobs are left out. Minneapolis only: St. Paul stopped publishing permits in mid-2025.
